notes:
Topline: Mid-market SaaS (customer onboarding flows) evaluating Redwood Hosted API as quick path, with Dedicated evaluation if latency/SLA or cost needs dictate. Primary product team (product + platform) driving decision; procurement + legal engaged.

Recent timeline / activities:
- 2026-02-20: Intro demo (hosted api chat streaming + tool calling) — Fireflies FF_20260220_7461. AE demo focused on streaming latency; PM quote: "must feel instant — onboarding flow can't flicker".
- 2026-02-28: Tech deep-dive with SE (Marco) — captured integration constraints, sample event schema, desired tool hooks (calendar, billing lookup). Shared mini-proto.
- 2026-03-05: POC kickoff call; agreed to 90-day trial scope for 2 onboarding flows + synthetic load tests (SE to provision endpoints) — Fireflies FF_20260305_9932.
- 2026-03-08: Security questionnaire submitted; legal requested DPA edits. Procurement asked for committed-cost options vs pure usage.

Use-case details / requirements (customer-specified):
- Workload: in-app guided onboarding copilots (multi-step guided flows that call tools and stream partial results). Also occasional support-chat reranking for help articles.
- Latency SLO: p95 streaming token latency target ~200-300ms; end-user perceived first token under 300ms for 90% of sessions. Need stable variance (no spikes).
- Throughput: expected peak sustained 40-60 reqs/s for active onboarding users, spike to ~120 reqs/s during launches.
- Cost sensitivity: tight token cost caps per session during trial (target <= $0.40/session on average); monthly spend budget for POC ~ $5k. Looking for Optimize suggestions (batching, cache) to keep cost predictable.
- Models: prefer smaller/faster open models for Hosted (Mistral-7B-like or Llama-2-chat-13B quantized fallback). Want ability to route to cheaper quantized variant on heavy load.
- Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to lower-cost variant + graceful degrade for tool-calls if higher tier unavailable.
- Integrations: streaming + function/tool-calling (calendar, user-profile, billing lookup), web SDK hooks, client-side streaming for progressive UI.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 baseline, SSO/SAML for admins, audit logs, KMS for keys, EU data residency for EU customers (may require Private/Dedicated later).

Procurement / pricing conversation notes:
- Customer intends to start on Hosted API to move fast. If p95 and cost targets cannot be met at scale, they will consider Dedicated reserved capacity.
- Procurement asked for committed capacity pricing example vs usage-based. Provided rough model worksheet (drive link). Legal wants explicit SLA language on latency and data handling before Dedicated commitment.

POC success criteria (agreed):
- Achieve p95 streaming-first-token <= 300ms under synthetic load representing 60 reqs/s steady + 120 reqs/s spike.
- Average token cost per session <= $0.40 with Optimize suggestions applied.
- Tool-calls succeed with <3% error rate and acceptable fallbacks.
- SSO test account integration complete and security questionnaire items at least in conditionally approved state.

Open items / next steps:
- AE/SE to deliver Dedicated pricing worksheet and example SOW (action: Lena / Marco) — due 2026-03-12.
- Legal to review DPA edits; follow-up with customer legal (action: Jordan).
- Customer to provide sample event schema + 10k synthetic sessions for load tests (action: HelixFlow eng).

Stated quotes / customer color: "We like how streaming looks, but if latency jumps at scale we can't ship — need predictability first." Short, choppy, CRM-style notes in call transcripts.

Quick links / artifacts: pricing deck (drive:/decks/helixflow-redwood-pricing-deck-v2.pdf), security Q&A (drive:/security/helixflow-security-qa-2026.md). Jira tickets opened for infra/perf tests (INF-2134) and security follow-up (SEC-441).

Sales posture: PLG-initiated but converting to sales-assisted for Dedicated; likely mid-April decision point if POC meets SLAs.
